title: Five-Step Descent Certificates for the Juggler Map: Parity Statistics of Nested Floor Powers
digest_convention: Text digests are taken over content, with CRLF and CR normalised to LF, as tools/artifact_digest.py does. pdf_sha256 and source_zip_sha256 are raw bytes, which is what a downloaded file holds. The 2026-09-10 record hashed text raw, so its source_sha256 described the packager's checkout rather than the manuscript, and it named an edition eleven revisions old.
mathematical_body_definition: SHA-256 of the manuscript after its closing YAML fence, leading newlines removed, line endings normalised to LF; the digested text begins '## Abstract'. The 2026-09-10 record printed a body digest that no line-aligned slice of its own deposited files reproduces.

changes_since_the_proof_audit_edition.summary: The attribution edition, in two passes on 19 September 2026. Section 1 gains two paragraphs stating that the word counts used here are Collatz word counts -- the shortcut Collatz map moves log x by -log 2 or +log(3/2) and the Juggler map moves log log n by the same two steps, so a word contracts in one problem exactly when it contracts in the other -- naming A076227 for the survivor counts, A100982 for the minimal certificates and A020914 for their admissible lengths, disclaiming priority for all three, and locating the contribution where the two problems part: Terras's bijection makes the fair-share densities free for Collatz, while for the Juggler map they are Hypothesis FD. Lemma 5.1 is labelled as verifying the first terms of A100982 rather than establishing them. In Section 6, Remark 6.2 notes that the survivor decay is a statement about Collatz residue classes as well; the barrier-step recursion is credited to Zarubin's 11 August 2019 formula on A076227, with Winkler's 12 September 2017 formula for the same counts and Hikawa's 21 July 2026 comment stating the surviving-word object; and the exponential rate and the d^(-3/2) power are disclaimed, the latter as conjectured in the three 2026 parity-vector preprints the entry links, which were not consulted. The Section 8 evidence table gains a row for the shared word counts. References 5 to 11 are the three OEIS entries, Winkler and those preprints. The acknowledgment records that the revision was drafted with Claude. No theorem, constant, exponent or proof changed; Theorems 3.1, 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4 are untouched.
